Bia Than phe Chu: Bia Than danh dau diem tuong tac cua phe Chu tai Phong Than Dai. Dang phuc dung thong tin; khong tu chuyen phe hay thay doi danh vong.
Bia Than phe Thuong: Bia Than danh dau diem tuong tac cua phe Thuong tai Phong Than Dai. Lua moi chi cung cap thong tin phe va chi dan trong map.
To Ho: Dau moi nhiem vu tan thu Giap Si. Hop Gam bat dau tai To Ho, sau do den Thu Kho trong Sung Thanh Doanh.
Lo Hung: Nhan vat trong chuoi Tan Thuc. Tim Au Thien Hoa va cac tuong Sung Thanh theo chi dan nhiem vu.
Au Thien Hoa: Tho ren trong chuoi Tan Thuc, Dung Dao va Kiem Ai. Co lien quan den sua vu khi; khong tu tao cong thuc ren khi chua co du lieu.
Sung Ung Buu: Tuong Sung Thanh trong chuoi Tan Thuc; lien he Lo Hung va tho ren Au Thien Hoa.
Sung Ung Loan: Dau moi Dung Dao va Kiem Ai. Nhiem vu dan nguoi choi toi Yen Son va quay lai Trieu Dien.
Trieu Dien: Tiep nhan cac bo phan dao trong chuoi Dung Dao, sau do huong dan toi tho ren.
Trieu Loi: NPC can thong bao trong chuoi Hop Gam cua To Ho va Thu Kho.
Sung Hau Ho: Tuong chi huy cua Sung Thanh Doanh, xuat hien trong chuoi Tan Thuc cua Giap Si.
Sung Hac Ho: Tuong Sung Thanh trong chuoi Tan Thuc. Tim Lo Hung de theo dung thu tu nhiem vu.
Trinh Luan: Nhan vat Sung Thanh da co ten va toa do trong danh muc. Lua tai dung cho phep tra cuu dia chi va cac NPC cung map.
Khao Co Hoc: Dau moi khao co, lien quan thong tin kho bau Phong Than. Chua co bang trao doi xac minh nen khong thu vat pham.
Thuong Diem: Diem giao dich duoc tai dung. Danh muc va gia ban rieng chua duoc xac minh; khong tu dung danh muc cua mot cua hang khac.
Chuyen Sinh Lao Lao: Dau moi chuyen sinh. Thu tuc can dieu kien cap, nhiem vu va vat pham dung phien ban; ban tai dung chua doi cap hoac thu nguyen lieu.
Tan Thu Thi Luyen: Huong dan tan thu: F3 xem thuoc tinh, F4 mo hanh trang, F5 xem ky nang. Tim NPC mon phai de tiep tuc nhiem vu goc.
Thuong Nhan Tay Vuc: Thuong nhan trong danh muc tan thu. Ban tai dung cung cap dia chi va tra cuu NPC; chua gan cong thuc thu cuoi cua NPC Tay Ky vao day.
Ho Tro Tan Thu: Ho tro thao tac: mo F4 de kiem tra vat pham, click phai de su dung hoac trang bi. Danh sach trong map giup tim nguoi giao nhiem vu.
Sinh Hoat Su: Huong dan he thong ky nang song. Chua mo hoc nghe hoac che tao vi can bang nghe, chi phi va dieu kien tuong ung.
Lao Rua: Dau moi Lao Rua duoc tai dung theo danh muc da duyet. Co the hoi dia chi va tra cuu nhung NPC lien quan trong map.
Pham Nghia: Nhan vat Pham Nghia tai Sung Thanh Doanh. Vai tro chi tiet chua duoc xac minh; ban tai dung chi mo doi thoai va tra cuu.
Nguyen Lam: Dau moi Nguyen Lam trong danh muc Sung Thanh. Cac cong thuc su kien co han su dung; khong ap dung lai phan thuong su kien cu.
Linh Bao Dai Phap Su: Nhan vat trong chuoi nhap mon Dao Si tai Ngoc Hu Cung. Tim Tu Hang Dao Nhan de theo thu tu tan thu.
Nam Cuc Tien Ong: Tien ong cua Ngoc Hu Cung, lien quan chuoi tan thu Dao Si va cac doi thoai chinh tuyen.
Kim Ha Dong Tu: Dong tu tai Ngoc Hu Cung. Co toa do trong danh muc Dao Si; su dung nhanh goc neu Lua tuong ung duoc tim thay.
Thieu Hao: Dau moi Khai Tri cua Di Nhan. Nghe loi chi dan cua cac totem tai Xi Vuu Mo roi quay lai phuc menh.
Hau Tho: Totem trong chuoi nhap mon Di Nhan tai Xi Vuu Mo. Lien he Thieu Hao de kiem tra tien trinh tan thu.
Phong Ba: Totem cua Xi Vuu Mo, mot dau moi trong chuoi huong dan Di Nhan.
Chuc Dung: Totem Chuc Dung tai Xi Vuu Mo. Dung Lua theo totem cua map nay, khong dung Lua Chuc Dung o Vien Co.
Cong Cong: Totem Cong Cong tai Xi Vuu Mo. Lua cua totem thuoc map nay, khong thay bang nhan vat Cong Cong o Bat Chu Son.
Hinh Thien: Dau moi Mao Lu: Di Nhan gap Hinh Thien, den Trieu Ca tim Ho Hy Mi, sau do quay lai phuc menh.
Cao Minh: Nhan vat ho tro dieu tra trong chuoi Di Nhan va nhiem vu hop thanh thu cuoi; Cao Giac la dau moi lien quan.
Hac Lao Nhan: Dau moi nhiem vu Tue Han tai Dong Quan. Nhan thuong va lich su kien chua duoc bat trong Lua tai dung.
Phong Lam: Dau moi Bat Tuy o Manh Tan; huong dan tim Ngo Long trong coc. Con lien quan Van Luong, nhung khong tu khoi tao xe luong.
Ngo Long: Nhan vat trong Bat Tuy. Tim chu tuu diem tai Trieu Ca theo loi chi dan, sau do quay lai Ngo Long.
Thuong Hao: Dau moi Co Dao cua Di Nhan tai Manh Tan. Co the hoi tien trinh trong nhanh Lua goc neu co du dieu kien.
Duong Tien: Dau moi Thien Cuong Tinh Quy Vi va Phu The tai Tay Ky. Ten trong Lua goc la Duong Tien, khong phai duong dan Nhi Lang Than o Dieu Tri.
Vo Vuong: Chu soai Tay Ky, nhan vat cua chinh tuyen. Ban nay la NPC doi thoai, khong phai Vo Vuong chien dau trong phu ban.
Nguoi Tay Vuc: Dau moi bien doi va hop thanh vat cuoi. Chuoi Thien Ngoai Phi Tien dan den Thay Tuong So va Cao Minh; chua tu bat cong thuc hop thanh.
Thay Tuong So: Dau moi tuong so va cac nhiem vu thu cuoi. Chuc nang phu thuoc map; khong lay Lua Tay Ky de thay cho Trieu Ca.
Vo Cat: Nhan vat Hoa Dia Vi Lao o Tay Ky. Lien he Tieu Bao va Xich Tinh Tu tai Ngoc Hu Cung.
Chuan De Dao Nhan: Dao nhan tai Tay Ky. Chua du bang doi thuong; doi thoai tai dung cung cap dia chi va thong tin lien quan trong map.
Phu An Su: Dau moi phu an duoc tai dung theo danh muc. Chua mo tieu hao phu hoac nang cap khi thieu bang vat pham va ty le.
Thong That Tau: Dau moi Thong That Tau trong thanh. Co the hoi vi tri va tra cuu cac NPC cung map; chua gan nhiem vu khong ro nguon.
A Tai: A Tai duoc tai dung tai thanh da duyet. Ban nay mo doi thoai thong tin, khong tu thu tien hay cap thuong.
Nham Dai Ca: Nhan vat trong nhiem vu Phu The: Nham Dai Tau nho hoan thanh tam nguyen; Duong Tien tai Tay Ky la dau moi ho tro.
Nham Dai Tau: Nguoi giao loi nho trong Phu The o Tay Ky. Tim Nham Dai Ca va Duong Tien de theo chuoi nhiem vu.
Tieu Bao: Dau moi Hoa Dia Vi Lao, chi dan ve Vo Cat dang dung trong vong Bach Khuyen.
Hoang Phi Ho: Dau moi chinh tuyen Giap Si tai Trieu Ca. Cac lua nhiem vu goc quyet dinh dieu kien va thu tu nhan/tra.
Dac Ky: Nhan vat trong cac chuoi nhiem vu cua Phong Than. Doi thoai duoc phan biet theo map, khong gan lai nhiem vu Trieu Ca cho Bat Chu.
Ho Hy Mi: Nhan vat lien quan thiep moi trong chuoi Mao Lu cua Di Nhan. Hoan tat doi thoai roi ve Hinh Thien.
Con Bac: Nhan vat nhiem vu tai Trieu Ca. Khong tao them tro ca cuoc hoac rut tien trong ban tai dung.
Chu Tiem Cam Do: Dau moi tiem cam do tai Trieu Ca. Khong tu dinh gia, ban hay xoa do cua nguoi choi khi chua co quy tac goc.
Tong Di Nhan: Nhan vat trong cac nhiem vu Trieu Ca. Ban doi thoai tai dung giu ten va vi tri, nhanh goc duoc uu tien neu co.
Chu Tuu Diem: Chu tuu diem lien quan binh ruou cua Ngo Long trong Bat Tuy. Nhan va tra vat pham theo Lua nhiem vu goc.
Cu Luu Ton: Dao nhan trong danh muc Trieu Ca. Lua Cu Luu Ton o Ngoc Hu khong duoc tu dong coi la nhiem vu cua map nay.
Tru Vuong: Nhan vat Tru Vuong doi thoai tai Trieu Ca. Khong tu tao boss su kien hoac bang rot vat pham.
Tho Hanh Ton: Nhan vat chinh tuyen tai Trieu Ca, lien quan chuoi Thong Thien. Theo doi tien trinh nhiem vu trong nhanh goc.
Hoang Thien Hoa: Nhan vat chinh tuyen tai Trieu Ca. Cung Tho Hanh Ton tham gia chuoi duoc Khuong Tu Nha chi dan.
Thai Thuong Lao Quan: Dau moi trang bi Tinh Quan. Chua bat nang cap vi can dung ma nguyen lieu, cap trang bi va cong thuc rieng cua VNG.
An An Tien Tu: Tien tu su kien tai Dieu Tri. Lich va phan thuong theo tung su kien; ban nay chi mo doi thoai, khong phat thuong cu.
Nu Oa Nuong Nuong: NPC su kien tai Dieu Tri. Khong dung Lua Nu Oa cua Bat Chu Thien Quan lam phan thuong cho su kien nay.
NPC Vang Bac Dong: Diem Vang-Bac-Dong trong danh muc Dieu Tri. Chua xac minh bang quy doi nen khong thu vang, bac hay dong.
NPC Trao Thuong: Dau moi trao thuong su kien. Khong cap qua khi chua co danh sach du dieu kien va moc thoi gian cua dot den bu.
Bao An Tien Sinh: Dau moi nhiem vu ky nang song. Ban tai dung mo huong dan, chua sua diem nghe hay thu nguyen lieu.
Hong Ty: Dau moi he thong Nghia Tu 2. Chua mo nhan nuoi hay thay doi Nghia Tu khi chua du du lieu ve dieu kien.
Yen Van: Dau moi Tan Trung Lai. Khong dat lai cap, ky nang hay thuoc tinh nhan vat khi chua co bang quy tac duoc kiem chung.
NPC VIP: Dau moi tinh nang VIP. Ban tai dung khong cong diem VIP, nap tien hay nhan qua khi chua co du lieu quyen loi.
Nguoi Than Bi 3: NPC Nguoi Than Bi co vi tri thay doi theo dot hoat dong. Ban test dung vi tri da chot; chua mo lich xuat hien va phat thuong.
Ly Tinh: Dau moi Ly Tinh tai Tran Duong trong chuoi Giap Si. Khong thay the bang boss hay nhiem vu cua Phong Than Dai.
Nguyen Soai: Chi huy chien truong Thuong Chu. Cac muc phe, diem chien cong va thuong can he thong tran dau; ban tai dung khong tu tao tran.
Tuong Linh Thuong: Tuong phe Thuong tren chien truong. Doi thoai chi dan, khong tu doi phe hoac cap chien cong.
Tuong Linh Chu: Tuong phe Chu tren chien truong. Doi thoai chi dan, khong tu doi phe hoac cap chien cong.
Tiep Dan Thuong: Tiep dan phe Thuong. Vao tran phai theo luong dang ky chien truong; chua dich chuyen vuot dieu kien tham gia.
Tiep Dan Chu: Tiep dan phe Chu. Chua mo vao tran neu khong co trang thai chien truong tuong ung.

Huyen Do Dai Phap Su: Dau moi cua vung Tien Ma. Lua tai dung phan biet voi Huyen Do o Ngoc Hu Cung; chua thay doi phe hay cap Tien Ma.
Lien Dang Ho Su: Dau moi lien quan Lien Dang phe Tien/Ma. Khong tu bat tat den hay cong diem khi chua du he thong chien truong.
Tu Hanh Su Tien: Tu Hanh Su cua phe Tien. Chi dan trong vung Tien Ma; ban tai dung khong chuyen phe hay tieu hao vat pham tu luyen.
Tu Hanh Su Ma: Tu Hanh Su cua phe Ma. Chi dan trong vung Tien Ma; ban tai dung khong chuyen phe hay tieu hao vat pham tu luyen.
Tao Bao: Nhan vat Tao Bao tai vung Bat Chu. Khong dung Lua Tao Bao cua Ngoc Hu Cung lam nhiem vu vung Tien Ma.
Ngo Chan Nhan: Dau moi Loi Dinh Khoi Liet: VNG yeu cau cap Tien Ma 50 va 45000 danh vong Tien Ma. Ban tai dung chua cap danh hieu.
Son Than Hong Bac: Son than trong vung Bat Chu Son. Doi thoai huong dan va tra cuu NPC; chua tu tao cac muc tieu nhiem vu.
Ly Nhau Ton Gia: Ton gia trong vung Bat Chu Son. Lua tai dung giu thong tin ten va vi tri, khong gan thuong chua xac minh.
Nam Minh Tu: Nhan vat trong vung Bat Chu Son. Co the tra cuu cac dau moi tu hanh va chi dan map.
Yen Thuc Di: Dau moi chuoi Thap Nhi Nhan Ngau tai Nguc Phap Son. Chua trieu hoi hoa than hay danh dau hoan tat khi chua co du luong nhiem vu.
Yen Ba Ich: Nhan vat lien quan chuoi Nhan Ngau, cung khu vuc Yen Thuc Di. Ban tai dung chi mo huong dan.
Mat Tham Tien Gioi: Mat tham phe Tien tai Nguc Phap Son. Khong tiet lo hoac sua trang thai phe cua nguoi choi; mo doi thoai chi dan.
Mat Tham Ma Gioi: Mat tham phe Ma tai Nguc Phap Son. Giu lua rieng, khong dung chung callback lam doi nhiem vu phe Tien.
Tieu Loi: Diem Tieu Loi trong danh muc nhiem vu. Ban tai dung la NPC doi thoai de kiem tra vi tri, chua mo chien dau hay rot do.
Duoc Su Ma: Duoc Su phe Ma tai Ban Tuyen Thanh Dia. Chua mo ban thuoc rieng khi chua xac minh danh muc cua he thong Tien Ma.
Duoc Su Tien: Duoc Su phe Tien tai Ban Tuyen Thanh Dia. Doi thoai chi dan, khong tu hoi phuc hoac tru tien nguoi choi.
Khuong Ngu Tich: Dau moi trong chuoi On Dinh Quan Tam tai Ban Tuyen Thanh Dia. Chua mo nhan/tra khi thieu ma vat pham va trang thai nhiem vu.
Y Giap Tien: Y Giap tai khu vuc phe Tien cua Ban Tuyen Thanh Dia. Giu muc chi dan rieng; chua cap vat pham nhiem vu.
Y Giap Ma: Y Giap tai khu vuc phe Ma cua Ban Tuyen Thanh Dia. Giu muc chi dan rieng; chua cap vat pham nhiem vu.
